Welcome to the channel for Point Game with Isaiah Thomas and C.J. Toledano! Each week, Thomas and Toledano sit down to break down the latest and greatest surrounding the league and occasionally pull from an all-star lineup of athletes, entertainers, and creators to dig into the real stories behind the highlights. 

Produced by Follow Through Studio in association with iHeart Media and Slow Grind Media and sponsored by DraftKings.
